_comment: Initial canary list — 12 companies across all three lanes Steven greenlit on 2026-06-17. scrape_hr.py enriches each with a likely HR exec (name + LinkedIn URL + email guess via public domain pattern). NO hand-picked individual names here; the scraper fills in via LinkedIn public search so the lane gets fresh real-time contacts instead of stale memorized ones. Volume is intentionally tiny — F500 is brand-sensitive, batch 1 is for Steven to review the actual outbound text before anything sends.
_lane_priority: f500_inhouse and hr_tech_midmarket are lane_priority=1 (primary buyers). hr_consulting_firm is lane_priority=2 (could be competitor — only test 1 in the canary).
_target_titles: Workforce Transformation Partner (HR consulting firms only)
